2609.35674.title: Tracing the Evolution of Oracle Bone Characters Across Three Millennia
2609.35674.paper_summary: Of the approximately 4,500 Oracle Bone Inscription (OBI) characters discovered from the Shang dynasty, only about 1,600 have been deciphered. Many computational approaches compare OBI with glyphs from one historical period at a time. However, during the evolution of Chinese characters, significant structural or semantic changes often occur in uncertain dynasties. A single-period reference may be insufficient when relevant forms change substantially between observed eras. Therefore, we propose the \textbf{Manifold-based Script Evolution Framework (MSEF)}, a framework that models the evolution series (OBI, Bronze, Seal, Clerical, Regular) of Chinese characters as the continual evolution of a manifold space. MSEF represents each character as an era-specific manifold point and learns continuous inter-era transition rules via Neural Ordinary Differential Equations. Both manifold space and transition dynamics can be trained end-to-end through character evolution pairs across any two eras.
2609.35674.paper_summary_zh: 大約在商朝發現的 4,500 個甲骨文字符中，只有約 1,600 個已被解讀。許多計算方法一次將甲骨文與某一歷史時期的字形進行比較。然而，在漢字的演變過程中，重要的結構或語義變化通常發生在不確定的朝代之中。當相關形式在觀察的時代之間發生顯著變化時，單一時期的參考可能不足。因此，我們提出了 \textbf{基於流形的字形演變框架 (MSEF)}，這是一個將漢字的演變系列（甲骨文、青銅文、篆書、隸書、楷書）建模為流形空間的持續演變的框架。MSEF 將每個字符表示為特定時代的流形點，並通過神經常微分方程學習連續的時代間過渡規則。流形空間和過渡動力學都可以通過任何兩個時代的字符演變對進行端到端的訓練。
